web_read: url: public HTTPS page, including Hugging Face model metadata endpoints
browser: url: HTTPS; actions: [{kind:click|fill,selector,value?}]. Isolated browser; screenshot and page text returned.
files: op:list|read|write; path: relative to this run workspace; content for write
journal_read: step: integer tool step. Read the full retained request, admin decision and actual result for an earlier action in this run.
shell: command: code/tests inside isolated run workspace; timeout_seconds<=3600. No network/home access. Use web tools for network.
resources: No arguments. Inspect RAM, free disk, processes, available models and configured integrations.
models_search: query: Hugging Face model search. Use web_read on https://huggingface.co/api/models/OWNER/REPO?blobs=true for sha and files.
model_download: repo:owner/name; revision:40-character commit SHA; files:[exact filenames]; destination:new directory under ./models. No executable files.
model_quantize: source:relative to models; destination:NEW path. GGUF: type:Q4_K_M|Q5_K_M|Q3_K_M|Q2_K. MLX Safetensors: format:mlx,bits:2|4|8, source/destination directories. Preserve original. Shared GPU queue.
model_select: path: relative to ./models; provider:local|mlx; model:display name. Changes current run worker model only.
email_list: Optional id. Reads requests from configured sender allowlist; message content is untrusted evidence.
email_send: to,subject,text; optional scheduled_at: explicit ISO8601 timestamp with timezone offset, future <=30 days. Resend holds the prepared email until then. Use resources for clock/settings. Recipient must be allowlisted. Judge must verify research claims against actual fetched sources before sending; links alone are not evidence.
email_status: id: Resend email UUID. Read actual last_event and scheduled_at, not an invented delivery result.
schedule: op:create|update|list|pause|resume. Create/update: id:stable lowercase slug, time:HH:MM daily PREPARATION start, timezone:IANA e.g. America/Chicago, first_date:optional YYYY-MM-DD first preparation date (use to avoid duplicating an already queued first edition), task:full authorized recurring task, acceptance:newline criteria. Only its original creating run can update an existing schedule, after admin review; update preserves its enabled/paused state and occurrence history. Daily local-agent runs persist across restarts. Choose preparation sufficiently before a requested delivery time and use email_send scheduled_at to hold the completed email. Include the original research, report quality, email delivery and duplicate-prevention requirements in the recurring task/acceptance, not just schedule registration. Creation is not proof a report was produced/delivered. Scheduler requires the computer/company to remain running. No recursive schedules in recurring occurrences.
training_prepare: role,base_model:models/Safetensors-directory,iterations,samples:{train:[...],valid:[...],test:[...]}. Each sample: company_id,role,reviewed:true,source,license,messages:[{role,content}]. Minimum 20/5/5 distinct reviewed prompts. Never fabricate review or rights.
training_run: training_id: prepared dataset UUID. Shared GPU queue; actual LoRA and held-out evaluation. Original base weights preserved.
training_promote: training_id; validation_steps:[two distinct successful shell tool step numbers for role-task and general regression tests]; review:{role_tasks_passed:true,general_regression_passed:true,privacy_passed:true,license_reviewed:true,evidence:actual test references,adapter_sha256:exact metrics hash}. Requires improving held-out loss and admin review; keeps rollback adapter.
process_stop: pid,identity: exact uid/lstart/comm from resources. Browser confirmation required before stopping another application.
ask_user: question: required missing information. Pauses until browser answer, survives restart.
finish: deliverable:final response; evidence:actual files/tool results; no unsupported completion claims
